about.title: About CK Pools
text: CK Pools is a family-owned pool service company built on over 37 years of hands-on experience in the pool industry. From fieldwork to operations, our team understands what it takes to keep pools clean, balanced, and performing at their best. As a trusted local pool company serving Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, San Antonio, and Austin, we bring practical knowledge and dependable service to every homeowner we work with.

What sets us apart is consistency. We specialize in pool cleaning, maintenance, repairs, leak detection, and remodeling, backed by transparent communication, detailed service reports, and a commitment to protecting your investment. Our goal is simple: reliable pool care that keeps your pool ready to enjoy all year round.
Get to know the experienced team behind CK Pools, friendly, knowledgeable pool professionals dedicated to cleaning and maintaining pools across Texas.
